events.title: v1.2.9 Update and a Development Status Update
events.summary: Hello everyone, We’d like to share the new features in this update, along with an honest update on the issues players have been experiencing and the work we’re doing to address them. What’s newAdded emotional expressions for your little sister.Added new hair customization options. Your sister can now show her emotions through her facial expressions during conversations.
